questions.stem: A vision model receives two images of the same machine. The app needs a concise caption comparing visible differences. What should be supplied?

options.text: Attach only the first image and describe the second image’s filename.
Both supported image inputs with an explicit comparison/caption instruction.
Attach both images but ask only for an independent caption of the first.
Send a text-only comparison request containing both image URLs as prose.

explanation.whyCorrect: The vision request must actually include both images using its supported image content shape. The instruction specifies comparison and desired detail.

whyDistractorsWrong.A: The second filename does not supply the second image.
whyDistractorsWrong.D: Plain prose URLs do not provide supported image content inputs.
whyDistractorsWrong.C: That instruction does not request the required visual comparison.

questions.stem: Complete a vision chat message so a question about a supplied inspection photo is grounded in actual image input.

options.text: Complete the configured fields.
Inspect all slot choices.

explanation.whyCorrect: The documented chat shape includes an image_url content part with its URL. The question text describes what to inspect; it does not provide pixels.

whyDistractorsWrong.kind: Use the image input content type for the vision chat surface.
whyDistractorsWrong.field: The image_url object contains the source; a filename or generated caption is not equivalent input.

questions.stem: The selected image model supports masking. Complete an edit request for a source image and a mask already sized to match it.

options.text: Inspect all slot choices.
Complete the configured fields.

explanation.whyCorrect: The supported edit consumes source image data and a spatial mask. Size and quality controls do not substitute for the edit mask.

whyDistractorsWrong.source: Supply the image bytes/file accepted by this endpoint, not its name or a caption.
whyDistractorsWrong.mask: Supply the matching mask as an input; a size/quality value is a different control.

questions.stem: A Translator text request contains one sentence with English and German spans. Some words remain untranslated. Which preparation targets the documented limitation?

options.text: Submit the same mixture to document translation with autodetection.
Retry the same mixed sentence until detection changes.
Provide a glossary while keeping the mixed-language sentence intact.
Segment by source language and translate each segment explicitly.

explanation.whyCorrect: The known-issues page distinguishes mixed-language text and document failures and recommends intended-source-language handling or single-language segmentation.

whyDistractorsWrong.C: Terminology customization does not remove the source-language mixture.
whyDistractorsWrong.B: Unchanged retries do not resolve the documented input limitation.
whyDistractorsWrong.A: Document translation also has documented mixed-language limitations.

sourceRefs.title: Azure Translator known issues and troubleshooting

questions.stem: A domain compliance summarizer needs a defined scope and an explicit escalation when evidence is missing. Which instruction design addresses it?

options.text: A deployment name containing compliance.
Domain instructions with a missing-evidence fallback.
A longer output limit alone.
A lower top-p value alone.

explanation.whyCorrect: System instructions define task scope and fallback, while evaluation checks behavior. Sampling, length and names do not establish those requirements.

whyDistractorsWrong.D: Sampling does not state the permitted task.
whyDistractorsWrong.A: A deployment label is not an instruction contract.

questions.stem: A blob OCR pipeline has imageAction none and incorrectly maps a skill-produced text node with fieldMappings. Which TWO changes repair the data path? Select TWO answers.

options.text: Keep imageAction none and use a larger searchable field.
Map enriched OCR text into the index with outputFieldMappings.
Move the OCR text mapping into the semantic query request.
Enable original-image extraction but keep the OCR text mapping in fieldMappings.
Generate normalized images for the OCR skill input.

explanation.whyCorrect: OCR needs normalized image inputs, and the enrichment output needs a mapping to the target index field. Fix both sides of the pipeline.

whyDistractorsWrong.A: Field size does not create normalized images.
whyDistractorsWrong.C: A query does not configure enrichment output ingestion.
whyDistractorsWrong.D: Image extraction alone does not repair the mapping for the skill-produced enriched node.

sourceRefs.title: Skillset concepts in Azure AI Search

questions.stem: A team uses Content Understanding SDK 1.1.0 for production document extraction. Which TWO implementation choices align with the referenced contract? Select TWO answers.

options.text: Use capabilities compatible with its 2025-11-01 API version.
Submit the same document repeatedly as a substitute for polling.
Wait for analysis completion before consuming the structured result.
Treat the initial poller as completed Markdown content.
Mix preview-only analyzer fields into the request with no version change.

explanation.whyCorrect: Match the SDK's supported API and follow the asynchronous analysis lifecycle. Completed structured content is available after successful completion.

whyDistractorsWrong.E: The feature and API versions must be compatible.
whyDistractorsWrong.D: The poller represents the long-running operation.

questions.stem: A custom analyzer must extract an amount from unfamiliar invoice layouts and support reviewer verification. Which TWO features or inputs are useful? Select TWO answers.

options.text: A high confidence threshold used as proof that all accepted values are correct.
Representative labeled examples with verified field values.
Generated explanations used as substitutes for labeled source values.
Removing source coordinates to standardize the JSON shape.
Field source and confidence estimation for the extraction results.

explanation.whyCorrect: Good labeled examples support extraction quality; confidence and grounding support review. Neither should be confused with independent verification.

whyDistractorsWrong.A: Thresholding does not create a correctness guarantee.

sourceRefs.title: Validate document analyzer quality with confidence, grounding, and labeled samples

questions.stem: Long manuals exceed embedding limits, and the query vectorizer uses an unrelated model. Which TWO configuration corrections address the two failures? Select TWO answers.

options.text: Chunk the source text within input limits.
Increase the answer-generation token limit.
Disable indexing warnings.
Rescale query vectors from the unrelated model.
Use content/query embeddings from a compatible model configuration.

explanation.whyCorrect: Chunking addresses embedding input size; compatible query/content vectors address representation mismatch. These are separate ingestion and retrieval requirements.

whyDistractorsWrong.B: Answer length does not enlarge embedding input limits.
whyDistractorsWrong.D: Rescaling does not align learned embedding spaces.
whyDistractorsWrong.C: Suppressing warnings does not fix either defect.

sourceRefs.title: Integrated vector embedding in Azure AI Search
